text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.16 for the Software Engineer (Front-end) position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications is their experience with "AWS". Key gaps include missing requirements for javascript, typescript, prototyping tools, nodejs, react, redux, sass/css, responsive/adaptive design, and animation library, as well as having less than the implied years of experience. This application was escalated for manual review despite the low fit and missing must-have qualifications.
